rules.statement: Article 12 of the Constitution cannot be invoked to challenge a violation arising out of contract, unless the by-law incorporated in the contract has been unequally applied.
rules.supporting_quote: "In order to invoke Article 12 of the Constitution on the ground of unequal treatment and discrimination the second petitioner must show that she has been treated differently from other persons similarly circumstanced without any rational basis and that such differential treatment was unjustifiable. The two persons who the petitioners alleged were differently treated cannot be said to have been similarly situate."

meta.parties: Roberts and Another v. Ratnayake and Others
